summary: Not ready, but close. All examples pass and the open questions are non-blocking. Three things block release. Decision D-036 has new evidence from the email-copy update and must be re-confirmed (error). Five dev-refinement questions are rated major; one shows a contradiction between D-007 and the AC-05.7.3 examples, and another shows a gap in D-037 when HR edits after submission. Several rules and stories cite facts outside their cited set; one row (separated → spouse date of birth) disagrees with D-003. After that, the main open items are the inferred child-tariff paths and four places where implementation wording leaks into the spec.

findings.title: D-036 has new evidence and must be re-confirmed
findings.why: This is the only error-level check. Five new email-copy facts touch D-036 (answers kept while the employee goes back and forth, and what gets submitted). Release can't happen while a decision is out of date against its evidence.
findings.evidence: decisions error on D-036: new facts F-hr_email_copy-029105, -37cede, -ab2538 and 2 more
findings.action: Re-check D-036 against the copy-email facts. Update the decision if it should also cover the copy, then run `pipeline reconfirm D-036`.

findings.title: Liechtenstein daily commuters: D-007 contradicts the AC-05.7.3 examples
findings.why: D-007 asks Liechtenstein residents every source tax question. But the examples show '–' for denomination and children in the 'in principle no source tax' rows. Under G-01, asking them would collect data that feeds no tariff code. This also decides the order of the source tax questions.
findings.action: Add a decision: ask the Liechtenstein daily-return and 45-day questions first, and close the source tax section early when there is in principle no liability. Then align D-007 and the AC-05.7.3 examples.

findings.title: HR edits after submission can open questions that were never answered
findings.why: D-037 says results are 're-derived from the latest answers'. But if HR changes residence, nationality or civil status, answers the result depends on (denomination, children, cross-border) were never collected. The tariff result is then undefined.
findings.action: Decide who supplies the missing answers: the questionnaire reopens for just those questions, or HR enters them. Also decide what HR sees in the meantime (an 'incomplete' status vs no tariff code). Record it in decisions.yaml.

findings.title: Scope: is the Zurich calculator logic used for residents of other cantons?
findings.why: Most staff are in Zurich, but residents of Aargau, St. Gallen and other cantons may need their own canton's church-tax rules or tariff rules. That would change the tariff computation and possibly the denomination question.
findings.action: Confirm with HR or a domain expert. Either record that the Zurich logic applies to all (Muster AG's tax office is Zurich), or exclude other cantons and add that to the exclusions.

findings.title: Some rules and stories cite facts outside their cited set; one row disagrees with D-003
findings.why: Some rows have no backing. One is a real content conflict: the Separated row in pension_fund_civil_status includes the spouse's date of birth, but D-003 says separated employees are entered as Married without it.
findings.evidence: trace_judge: rule.pension_fund_civil_status; rule.single_parent_h_tariff (c78e0c); rule.cross_border_tariff_applies (bc1639, 52b67a); rule.source_tax_result (b6d9b3); US-04.3/05.4/06.1/08.1 (d7431e, b6d9b3); US-08.3 (Julia incident); 'H tariff' purpose on 8 child items
findings.action: Fix the Separated row to match D-003/D-004, or update D-003. Add the missing fact refs to the cited sets. Add a cited fact or decision behind the 'H tariff' purpose of the child items.

findings.title: Inferred child-tariff paths have not been checked against the calculator
findings.why: Lonio now owns the tariff result. About 15 example rows in US-06.2–06.5 are marked 'inferred, to verify', and US-06.4 extends a rule to divorced and widowed employees without a source. A wrong path gives HR a wrong tariff code.
findings.evidence: OQ-calculator-coverage (D-009); inferred stories US-06.2, US-06.3, US-06.5, US-06.6; trace_judge US-06.2/06.3/06.4
findings.action: Keep domain-expert verification as a stated go-live condition. Ideally run the inferred paths through the calculator now and replace 'inferred' with observed facts.

findings.title: Non-return days 'in the calendar year' are unclear for employees who start mid-year
findings.why: The answer, and possibly the question text, depends on which period counts. Without a rule, employees starting in, say, November will answer inconsistently, and the cross-border tariff may be wrong.
findings.action: Clarify with a domain expert which period applies: rest of the year, projected full year, or next year. Record a decision and adjust the question wording.

findings.title: Saving an unfinished questionnaire and finishing deadline not defined
findings.why: This affects how D-036 retention works, reminders, and what happens before the first working day. Engineering can't size the flow without it.
findings.action: Decide whether the employee can save and come back later, whether there is a deadline (e.g. before the first working day), and what happens to an unsubmitted questionnaire. Fold this into the D-036 re-confirmation.

findings.title: Implementation wording in the spec
findings.why: Phrases like 'repeating child block', 'add/remove', 'Expressions' and storing 'source tax questions apply' as its own value prescribe UI or storage design instead of the business need.
findings.evidence: tech_leak: US-06.1, feature.md notes, US-04.3, information.md
findings.action: Rephrase as needs: 'each child is assessed separately'. Drop the 'Expression' wording and drop recording the intermediate 'questions apply' value.

findings.title: Smaller gaps to tidy up
findings.why: These cause rework during refinement if left open.
findings.evidence: dev_refinement: AC-01.2.1 table shows '–' for country in the Switzerland row; US-08.4 has no check on the copy address and the copy holds sensitive data; US-08.1 has no owner for the permit-reminder wording; coverage: F-pension_portal-3a97ab unused
findings.action: Correct the AC-01.2.1 table. Decide on confirming the copy address and whether the copy includes question texts. Name who supplies the reminder text. Cite F-pension_portal-3a97ab in US-02.2 as the reason for the mid-month rule.
